title: ohhi.layout.v1
description: An Oh hi markdown layout file: <vault>/.ohhi/layouts/<name>.json (or ~/.config/ohhi/layouts/ on desktop). A partial over the layout it extends. See docs/customising.md.

extends.description: A layout by name ("default", the one built-in, or a file name); this file's values and deltas apply over it. "light" and "dense", built-ins before, are read as "default".

regions.description: What each region of the shell is. statusbar "merged" needs header "toolbar": the merged readouts ride the toolbar.

rail.description: "menu" is read as "dock", its name before.

bars.description: Plain ids REPLACE the inherited list; "+id" appends, "-id" removes (a list is one or the other); "|" is a separator. "note.pill" and "people" are read as "sync". The "sync" invariant, three rules: "sync" must be in the bar on screen (one of the toolbar's groups when regions.statusbar is "merged", statusbar otherwise); regions.statusbar "merged" is refused unless regions.header is "toolbar"; focus.keep must keep the region whose bar carries it.

toolbar.left.description: Readout ids: the toolbar's left end.

toolbar.right.description: Readout ids: the toolbar's right end.

format.description: The format bar (placed by regions.format): command ids, shown as buttons, and the grouped toolbar items.

statusbar.description: Readout ids: the bar under each pane (regions.statusbar "pane").

status.description: Readout ids: the corner at the editor's bottom right (regions.status "corner"), by default the word and character counts.

tabs.description: Command ids, shown as faint buttons at the end of every pane's tab strip (by default split right and split down).

dock.description: Where the floating dock sits when regions.rail is "dock".

views.description: Decides which view commands the command palette offers (same list grammar); an empty list offers every registered view.

keep.description: Regions Focus mode keeps on screen. Must keep the region whose bar carries "sync" (toolbar when merged, statusbar otherwise).
